findings.current: The man moved carefully across the room.
findings.defect: The draft omits that the man steps forward, speaks again, and deliberately puts force into his voice.
findings.rationale: The source explicitly preserves both his careful movement and the renewed force behind his speech.
findings.replacement: The man cautiously stepped forward and spoke again, his voice firm.
findings.source:
스윽.

조심스럽게 걸음을 옮긴 남자가 힘주어 재차 입을 열었다.

findings.current: That fucking bastard is barely younger than me, but he picks fights over everything and acts like a complete jackass.
findings.defect: The draft invents that Section Chief Kim is younger. The source specifies only that they are not far apart in age.
findings.rationale: 나이 차이도 얼마 안 나면서 gives no direction to the age difference.
findings.replacement: That fucking bastard isn’t even that far from me in age, but he picks fights over every little thing and acts like a complete jackass.
findings.source: 그 시발롬은 나이 차이도 얼마 안 나면서 사사건건 시비 걸고 지랄이야.

findings.current: No. Becoming one is beside the point. I thought you’d die from an orgasm while watching porn before you ever got there.
findings.defect: The draft makes the euphemism more explicit and changes 복상사, death during sex, into death specifically from an orgasm.
findings.rationale: 복상사 refers euphemistically to dying during sex; the source does not explicitly identify orgasm as the cause.
findings.replacement: No. Becoming one is beside the point. I thought you’d drop dead in the act while watching porn before you ever got there.
findings.source: 아니. 되는 건 둘째치고 난 형이 조만간 야동 보다가 복상사할 줄 알았지.

findings.current: Thanks to the System’s permission, I could now freely log in and out without the capsule.
findings.defect: The established System terms Login and Logout are not used.
findings.rationale: The binding glossary requires 로그인 and 로그아웃 to be rendered as Login and Logout.
findings.replacement: Thanks to the System’s permission, I could now freely use Login and Logout without the capsule.
findings.source: 시스템이 허락한 덕분에 캡슐이 없어도 자유자재로 로그인과 로그아웃을 할 수 있게 되었으니까.

findings.current: As Jin-ho hyung began bringing up what happened when I first logged out, I hurriedly changed the subject.
findings.defect: The established System term Logout is replaced with the ordinary verb phrase logged out.
findings.rationale: The binding glossary requires 로그아웃 to be rendered as Logout.
findings.replacement: As Jin-ho hyung began bringing up what happened after my first Logout, I hurriedly changed the subject.
findings.source: 처음 로그아웃했을 때의 이야기를 꺼내는 진호 형의 모습에, 나는 황급히 화제를 돌렸다.

findings.current: I nodded inwardly, breathing a sigh of relief.
findings.defect: The draft attaches inwardness to the physical nod instead of the sigh, producing the impossible action “nodded inwardly” and altering which response is outwardly visible.
findings.rationale: 내심 modifies the relieved sigh, while 고개를 끄덕였다 is a physical nod.
findings.replacement: I breathed an inward sigh of relief and nodded.
findings.source: 나는 내심 안도의 한숨을 내쉬며 고개를 끄덕였다.

findings.current: His eyes, slowly closing beneath a blanket of blood in the red snow.
findings.defect: The draft places his eyes beneath a blanket of blood, whereas the source says he was in a red, blood-covered snowfield.
findings.rationale: 피로 뒤덮인 modifies 붉은 눈밭, not his eyes.
findings.replacement: His eyes slowly closing in the red snowfield covered with blood.
findings.source: 피로 뒤덮인 붉은 눈밭에서 서서히 감기던 눈동자가 생각났다.

findings.current: Jin-ho hyung laughed carefree and continued.
findings.defect: “Laughed carefree” is ungrammatical because the adjective is used where an adverbial phrase is required.
findings.rationale: 태평하게 describes his unconcerned manner, which the replacement conveys in natural English.
findings.replacement: Jin-ho hyung laughed without a care and continued.
findings.source: 태평하게 웃은 진호 형이 말을 이었다.

findings.current: Along with the faint mutter of someone small reaching my ears, I moved on.
findings.defect: The draft makes the speaker physically small. Here 자그마한 describes the subdued mutter, not the size of the person.
findings.rationale: The source conveys a small or quiet utterance; it does not identify the speaker as a small person.
findings.replacement: With someone’s quiet mutter reaching my ears, I walked on.
findings.source: 귓가에 닿은 자그마한 누군가의 중얼거림과 함께, 나는 걸음을 옮겼다.

summary: The draft contains one altered physical action, two changed mechanical details, an unsupported age relation, binding terminology mismatches, and several localized omissions or unnatural renderings.
